text.en:
While holding down the trigger:
Every successive shot grants -10% Accuracy Cone Size and +1 Stability, up to -100% Accuracy Cone Size and +10 Stability after firing 10 shots.

Effect at maximum strength removes all spread.

enhanced (
#e Effect reaches maximum strength after 8 shots.
)
text.zh-chs:
当按下扳机时：
每次命中都将 -10% 精度锥角尺寸并 +1 稳定性，10 次命中可达到最高 -100% 精度锥角尺寸并 +10 稳定性。

效果达到最高值时即完全没有子弹散布。


enhanced (
#e 8 次命中即可达到效果最高值。
)

text.en:
Each shot grants #e${-5*#d}% Accuracy Cone Size, #e${-10*#d}% Accuracy Cone Growth, and #e${1*#d} Stability while holding down the trigger.

Reaches maximum strength after #e${10/#d} shots.

#e Effect reaches maximum strength 2 shots sooner.
)
